statement: At fixed cutoff and positive floor in the retained A1/A7 antipodal p:2p final-fresh-root chart, condition on the strict past and use the actual production incidences z_a=S_x a, u_i,a=S_v,i a, with n_i=partial_i m and S_v,i=partial_i S_x. Under the registered common-even jointly Gaussian law, zero same-point field-current cross covariance and Gamma_Lambda,i=Gamma_<,i+Gamma_>,i, the fresh-current quadratic covariance cancels exactly against the Gamma_>,i part of the A7 trace. The conditional endpoint is one half the integral of the sum of (n_i+u_i,a)^T Bbar_a(n_i+u_i,a)-Tr(Bbar_a Gamma_<,i). Its first variation, full symmetric bilinear Hessian, terminal-sixth and source Hessians, curved-chart connection, and multiplication-form domain are exact. The one-tenth gap remains equivalent to K_E+K_6>=-4I/5 almost surely on the localized predictable core. Spatial Cauchy gives the conditional L2 collar C_2,p=[8 sqrt(3)L6|p|/(V lambda_2)]A_n A_W+[4 sqrt(3)H6/(V lambda_2)]A_n A_Y+[2H6/(V lambda_2)]A_n^2. For the control-generated mean, the exact A1 symbol gives ||grad m_h||_2^2<=c_grad||h_-||_S^2 with c_grad=1/(2 sqrt(c)-a)=2.033300406271083...<41/20. A nondegenerate uncancelled derivative-active Gaussian past has unbounded absolute-collar support and positive-probability violation of every finite threshold; event-localized predictable directions show that an all-directions weighted collar is again fiberwise. The separated current envelope also inherits the registered A1 q^-4 ultraviolet growth, while the signed future-current/trace cancellation itself remains finite. These are a scoped conditional theorem and method boundary, not the complete progressive production Hessian or a production Loewner bound. T-050, A13, Nelson, every phase/PDE verdict, and Sector A remain open.

no_overclaim: R-153 identifies the exact final-fresh-root strict-past conditional endpoint, its first variation and bilinear Hessian, a conditional spatial-L2 collar, and a control-generated mean gradient bound. It proves that a nondegenerate derivative-active Gaussian past cannot satisfy the deterministic absolute collar uniformly. It does not construct the complete progressive production Hessian, prove the Loewner bound, close T-050 or A13, prove Nelson or an interacting measure, select any phase, validate or replace a PDE, or close Sector A.
